simple.subtitle: When you are busy grooming, MagicHango follows up with missed callers by SMS, collects pet and address details, and suggests appointment times that actually fit your route.

before.title: Before MagicHango
before.subtitle: Late callbacks turn into awkward bookings, extra driving, and a broken day.
before.footer: Every missed call handled late makes it easier to accept the wrong time slot. The day looks busy, but too much of it disappears into driving and dead gaps.

idleGap.title: Awkward gap
idleGap.meta: Too late to fill well, too early to end the day

after.title: After MagicHango
after.subtitle: Qualified requests lead to cleaner routing, better slot choices, and one more booking.
after.footer: MagicHango does not book blindly. It prepares the request, suggests the best route-friendly slots, and lets the groomer approve before anything is confirmed.

animation.helper: Switch between both states to see how a better booking order creates a tighter day.
animation.mapsHint: Click to open in Google Maps
animation.beforeReasonOne: When missed callers wait too long, you often end up accepting the first slot that works instead of the right slot for the route.
animation.beforeReasonTwo: That creates long drives, awkward gaps, and a last stop that leaves you far from home.
animation.beforeReasonThree: The day looks full, but too much revenue is lost to travel and preventable friction.
animation.afterReasonOne: MagicHango texts the missed caller quickly and collects the pet, service, and address details up front.
animation.afterReasonTwo: That makes it possible to suggest time slots that fit the route instead of forcing the day around a bad booking.
animation.afterReasonThree: You approve the best option before confirmation, which means better routes and less back-and-forth.
